question: Netanyahu drops out before election?
resolution_criteria: Yes if Netanyahu definitively announces he will not run in the October 27, 2026 election by October 26, 2026, 11:59 PM Jerusalem time. Resolves with Polymarket market netanyahu-drops-out-before-election.

history.rationale: Sprint forecast for fast resolutions. No independent news view: this is the market price 1.8% with the standing favorite-longshot rule (prices under 10% or over 90% moved 30% closer to the edge, in between left as is). It tests whether that rule beats the market.
